messages.subject: product plot "how-to"
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know a good resource for learning how to use product plot? I've seen the paper on it, for its motivation, but it lacks any mechanical instruction. And the documentation gives very few details.

I was expecting a book to be published, but didn't know. Does anyone have an idea? Thanks.


Adam Loveland
